title: Closed-Door Boundary Disputes
summary:
*   A special, private meeting was held to discuss potential legal action.
*   The sole agenda item was anticipated lawsuits regarding disputes over the city's extraterritorial jurisdiction (its authority outside city limits).
*   No public announcements or policy decisions were made following the closed-door session.
